content: The study was registered on September 20, 2013, under the identification number NCT01687998. Eligibility Criteria Inclusion Criteria: 1. Participants must have a diagnosis of high-risk vascular disease (HRVD), which is defined as meeting at least one of the following diagnostic criteria: A history of acute coronary syndrome (ACS), specifically between 30 days and 365 days after discharge for ACS. Cerebrovascular atherosclerotic disease. Peripheral arterial disease. Diabetes mellitus with documented coronary artery disease, provided the participant is clinically stable as determined by the responsible physician. 2. Participants must have been treated with a statin for at least 30 days prior to the screening. Exclusion Criteria: 1. Participants with clinically active liver disease are excluded. However, individuals with Gilbert's syndrome or a history of cholelithiasis/cholecystectomy are not excluded. 2. A history of malignancy within the 3 years preceding the screening is an exclusion criterion. 3. Participants with known malabsorption syndromes, except for lactose intolerance, are excluded. 4. Individuals with a known history of primary or secondary hyperaldosteronism are excluded. 5. Participants with a history of intolerance or hypersensitivity to cholesterol ester transfer protein (CETP) inhibitors are excluded. 6. Any clinically significant medical condition that, in the investigator's opinion, could interfere with participation in the study will result in exclusion. 7. Participants with a life expectancy of less than 4 years are excluded. 8. Individuals who are unable or unwilling to comply with study requirements, or who are deemed unfit for the study by the investigator, are excluded. 9. A history of drug, alcohol, or substance abuse within the past 6 months, as assessed by the investigator, is an exclusion criterion. 10. Concurrent or anticipated need for treatment with niacin at doses greater than 250 mg/day, or chronic administration of drugs on the exclusion list, will result in exclusion. 11. Participants with prior exposure to CETP inhibitors, specifically dalcetrapib or evacetrapib within the last 3 months, or anacetrapib within the last 12 months, are excluded. 12. Any planned coronary angiography or coronary revascularization procedure is an exclusion criterion. However, participants may be screened and enrolled after all such planned procedures are completed.
